dialogue.happy: Much obliged, friend. This'll do fine.

name: Traveler
description: "Something refreshing" — wants light, fruity, cool drinks

dialogue.happy: Ah! Just what I needed after the road. You're a lifesaver.
dialogue.unhappy: I expected better from a brewer of your reputation.

name: Soldier
description: "Something STRONG" — wants high-alcohol, aged, intense drinks

dialogue.happy: NOW that's a proper drink! This'll warm the bones.
dialogue.neutral: It'll do. Not what I hoped for, but it'll do.
dialogue.unhappy: This is fit for children, not soldiers!

name: Noble
description: "Surprise me with your finest" — wants rare+ recipes, complex flavors

dialogue.happy: Exquisite! You have a true craftsperson's touch. Well done.
dialogue.neutral: Adequate. Though I've tasted finer at court.
dialogue.unhappy: I expected better from someone with your reputation.

name: Royal Taster
description: "The King sends me" — wants legendary recipes, pays huge amounts

dialogue.happy: The King will be most pleased. You have our gratitude and our patronage.
dialogue.neutral: Acceptable. The King will drink it. He may not love it.
dialogue.unhappy: The King sent me for excellence. This is not it.

name: Scholar
description: "What have you discovered?" — wants complex, historically interesting brews

dialogue.happy: Fascinating! The flavor structure suggests... yes, I see it now. Brilliant.
dialogue.neutral: Interesting. Though not quite what I expected.
dialogue.unhappy: I was expecting more sophistication, frankly.

name: Alchemist
description: "Show me something strange" — wants unusual, unexpected, surprising combinations

dialogue.happy: Magnificent! I've never experienced anything quite like this. You're a true innovator.
dialogue.neutral: Interesting. Not quite what I hoped for, but novel enough.
dialogue.unhappy: I came for the unexpected, not the mediocre.

name: Dreamer
description: "Something that feels like magic" — wants ethereal, floral, otherworldly brews

dialogue.happy: Oh... it's beautiful. Like tasting a dream itself.
dialogue.neutral: It's nice. Though I expected to feel more transported.
dialogue.unhappy: This is too heavy. Where is the magic?

name: Warrior
description: "Test my mettle" — wants challenging, intense, fire-inducing brews

dialogue.happy: HA! That's more like it! Burns right down to the soul!
dialogue.neutral: Decent heat. I've had better though.
dialogue.unhappy: Is this for warriors or for babes?

name: Healer
description: "Something restorative" — wants herbal, medicinal, nourishing brews

dialogue.happy: Perfect. This will help my patients recover. You have a gift.
